label.purpose: The label of a box or a field, in uppercase.

section-label.purpose: A section title on a rule, in uppercase.

motion.name: potion-swirl
motion.purpose: The liquid of the logo. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: The default ghost button: an ink border, a transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--panel); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Solid button
components.description: The main action of a page or a dialog. A pressed Toggle has the same look.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A boxed field with its label above it, in Inter caps.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; justify-items: start; gap: 3px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-input { font: inherit; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-raised); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 3px 8px; width: 100%; max-width: 26rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flag tab
components.description: A navigation tab of the shell. The current tab is solid.
components.html: CharactersImport
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; gap: 6px; justify-items: start; } .ds-tab { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--flag-ink); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--flag-yellow) 55%, #fff); padding: 11px 14px 11px 16px; } .ds-tab-blue { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--flag-blue) 55%, #fff); } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--flag-yellow); box-shadow: 0 3px 6px -4px var(--note-shadow); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Token
components.description: One pick on a form: its name and an X that removes it.
components.css: .ds-token { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 28px; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-raised); border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 1px 2px 1px 9px; } .ds-token-x { font: inherit; color: var(--ink-muted); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-token-x:hover { color: var(--danger); border-color: currentColor; background: var(--panel); } .ds-token-x:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Framed box
components.description: A value in a box with its label under it.
components.css: .ds-box { display: inline-grid; gap: 6px; background: var(--paper-raised); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px 6px; } .ds-box-value { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.1; text-align: center; color: var(--ink); } .ds-box-label { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); padding-top: 4px; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

components.name: Alert note
components.description: A flat note above the page content. Yellow: the user must act.
components.css: .ds-alert { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--note-ink); background: var(--note); padding: 11px 14px 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -5px var(--note-shadow); } .ds-alert a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-alert a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--note-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Use bubble
components.description: The frame around a feature with limited uses.
components.html:
Channel Divinity
Short rest
components.css: .ds-bubble { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding: 8px 14px 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bubble); border: 1.5px solid var(--info); border-radius: 18px; } .ds-bubble-head { display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; font-weight: 600; } .ds-use { width: 15px; height: 15px; padding: 0; background: var(--bubble); border: 1.5px solid var(--info); border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; } .ds-use:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-bubble-tag { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); }

narrative.overview:
The app must feel like a physical character sheet, but it does not copy paper literally. The page is a slightly yellow off-white with a subtle grain. The text is graphite-dark, in a serif face. Boxes have plain borders, with the label under the value, as on a printed sheet. Color is rare and each color has one meaning: a yellow note for something the user must act on, red for a failure, blue for a limited-use feature and for focus.

The app shell is a binder. A margin rail on the left holds the logo and the navigation, and a red double rule separates it from the page. Each page of the navigation has a flat flag tab that is stuck to the rule.

The Dark theme is not dark paper. It is OLED black and white: a pure black page, white text, and accents that shift to suit black. The notes and the flag tabs stay bright in the Dark theme, with black text.

The authority for each value and rule in this file is `docs/design/theme.md`. When this file and `theme.md` disagree, `theme.md` wins. The homebrew forms are in `docs/design/homebrew-forms.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Paper page, ink text, ink borders. No gradients and no decoration that a paper sheet could not have.
Each color is a role token. The name says what the color does.
Serif for content, small sans caps for labels.
A sheet that a user reads in a few seconds at the table, on a laptop or a phone.
Text labels only. There is no icon set.

rules.name: The Role Token Rule
rules.body: Use only the role tokens of `packages/ui/theme.css`. The default Tailwind colors are removed from the app. Do not write a raw hex value in a component.

rules.name: The Red Means Failed Rule
rules.body: Red is never a tab color and never decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text has a contrast of 4.5 : 1 or more on its background. Field borders and marks have 3 : 1 or more. The two themes obey this rule (WCAG 2.2 AA). A unit test in `packages/ui` computes each pair. When you add a text token, add its pair to the test.

rules.name: The Underlined Link Rule
rules.body: A link is Ink with an underline. It is not blue.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Fonts Rule
rules.body: The fonts come from `@fontsource-variable/newsreader` and `@fontsource-variable/inter`. The app makes no font request to a third party.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Newsreader is for content and Inter is for labels and controls. Do not add a third face.

rules.name: The Stuck Things Rule
rules.body: A box, a button and a field have no shadow. A shadow means that the thing is on top of the paper.

dos: Do read `docs/design/theme.md` before you change a token, a control or a layout rule. It wins over this file.
Do use the role tokens and the components of `@orc-alchemy/ui`.
Do use the terms of `GLOSSARY.md`: stuck note, alert note, use bubble, picker, token.
Do make each page work in the Light theme and the Dark theme, and at 390px wide.
Do show a current / max pair as the current value at full size, then `/ max` in Muted Ink.
Do obey `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` for each motion.
donts: Don't let a stuck note cover the content of the box that it marks.
Don't use a stuck note for information that needs no action. Use Warning Yellow text.
Don't use red for a thing that did not fail.
Don't import a control from `@base-ui/react` in the app. Import it from `@orc-alchemy/ui`.
Don't add icons. The app uses text labels.
Don't make the Dark theme a dark paper color. It is black and white.
Don't load a font from a third party.
